assumptions.text: A sweep costs 7 units of the thermodynamic reserve. Test assumption; not Landauer-derived, not canon.
The reserve at Kap 6 is 64, taken from clock-b.json, which calls itself a proposal.
A sweep masks the oldest unmasked simulated memory. Test assumption about the effect's shape.
The counterfigure is Kael (IC of B). Who is played, and whether Kael is the right counterfigure for later cases, is the author's call.
AEGIS-monolithisch cannot act after chapter 39 (Q8). The scenario endpoint is encoded as endpoint_chapter = 39.
The anomaly, the memories and every in-world sentence here are invented test state, not manuscript prose.
